description: `prose --output json cost` prints the INVOCATION_INVALID envelope whose suggestedArgv is `cli run quote --help`, and the Action names `cli wallet usage`.

problem.action: Past spending is `cli wallet usage`. Use `cli run quote`; `prose --output json cli run quote --help` shows its arguments.

details.reason: `cost` is not a command; did you mean `prose --output json cli run quote --help`? `cli run quote FILE` prices a run before it starts; past spending is `cli wallet usage`. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
